pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular, angular patches with sharp edge gradients and jagged vertices. Patch size is largest on the neck and shoulder regions, exhibiting dark brown pigmentation.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored pathways separating the patches. Features clear tri-axial junction nodes with consistent pixel width across the visible flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible mane along the superior neck line with a low-amplitude, bristled silhouette against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible preputial sheath on the ventral-posterior midline.
